scanners.content_policy: Only literal app-setting values are concatenated with blank-line separators. Documented Key Vault reference strings are excluded; unsupported reference-shaped strings yield UNKNOWN. No keys, reference values or site metadata are scanned as leak content.

bounds_and_cleanup.transport: Direct HTTPSConnection to fixed management.azure.com with default TLS validation; no environment proxy routing, redirects, arbitrary URLs or generic request cache. Exact routes from validated native names, no query/fragment/percent-encoded aliases. Debug output forced off. Declared content length/content type/encoding and bounded incremental read checked, duplicate JSON fields and non-finite JSON rejected.
bounds_and_cleanup.cleanup: Responses and connections closed in finally on success, malformed body, denial and limits; payloads remain memory-only, passed via shared offline scanner stdin/SDK, no content files or extraction directories. Shared result cache retains redacted canonical results and HMAC keys only. Python memory is not guaranteed cryptographic erasure.

permissions_doc.heading: Azure / Optional selected app-settings secret scanning
permissions_doc.grants_recommended: Only exact read/list actions at selected site/slot scope; no Contributor or write grants. config/list/Action itself grants access to broader sensitive configuration in Azure, while the implementation admits only the appsettings/list route. No Key Vault permission or secret-value reads requested.

first_run_note: The first run had 110 PASS and one test-only invalid native site-name canary; witness moved to a syntactically valid resource-group name. The value-hidden assertions were preserved; no runtime safety guard was weakened.

official_source_review.claim: Exact native site GET route and Site response identity.
Exact slot GET route and Site slot resource type.
POST is documented retrieval; StringDictionary id/name/type/properties shape and no write request payload.
Separate exact slot appsettings POST read route and dictionary response.
Site/slot read plus sensitive config/list/Action are distinct grants; metadata Reader is insufficient.
Documented SecretUri or VaultName/SecretName/optional SecretVersion reference forms; excluded without resolution.

proof_limits: No live cloud/authentication or RBAC exercise: native fixtures independently model current official REST shapes and exact routes. API success is configuration/read evidence, not effective access or credential validity.

Coverage is selected observed literal values only, bounded detector rules; absence of detection does not classify every possible secret format. No application code, connection-string endpoint, image layers, logs, historical settings or unselected sites/slots are scanned.
Reference-only, empty dictionary or empty literal-only targets are UNKNOWN, not clean PASS; valid Key Vault references are not leak findings and no intended secret-store payloads are fetched.

Strict selected name subset accepts bounded safe ASCII resource-group/site/slot segments; unsupported/escaped/unicode selection forms reject before auth rather than receiving synthetic compliance. Only Azure public ARM host is supported; sovereign management endpoints are unsupported.
The app-settings dictionary is one non-paginated native point-in-time read; no atomic deployment snapshot, all-service coverage or historical leak absence is claimed.
